AdminConfig.title: Extraction Config
AdminConfig.codexNote: Codex runs an agentic CLI to read scraped pages. It is pinned to a read-only sandbox, but an agentic CLI can still read local files, so a crafted page could read (not write or execute) host data. The page is sanitized and fenced as untrusted first. For the strongest isolation, prefer an API provider.
AdminConfig.claudeCodeNote: Claude Code runs a local CLI to read scraped pages, locked to text-only inference with every tool disabled, so scraped page content cannot trigger file or command access.
AdminConfig.apiKeySavedPlaceholder: Saved — paste a new key to replace
AdminConfig.apiKeySavedHint: A key is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it. Stored encrypted; falls back to the {envKey} environment variable.
AdminConfig.apiKeyNewHint: Paste a key to store it (encrypted) here, or set the {envKey} environment variable. No restart needed.
AdminConfig.customModelPlaceholder: Or type a custom model ID
AdminConfig.extractionTimeoutHint: Default 90. Raise this for slow CPU bound local models that exceed the default and time out.
AdminConfig.maxFlightsPerDateHint: Default 10. Raise to 20-30 for busy routes (JFK-LAX, LHR-CDG) where 10 flights may miss afternoon or budget options. Higher values use more LLM output tokens per scrape.
AdminConfig.maxTrackedPerRouteHint: Default 10. How many flights a user can select to track from one route in the results picker. The selection is also bounded by Max flights per date, since you can only pick from the flights that were extracted.
AdminConfig.maxPreviewCombosHint: Default 24. Caps routes x dates for the create-time preview scrape only; the recurring cron always covers the full grid. Raise it for wide multi-airport flex searches, but each combination is a live page load, so higher values make creating a tracker slower.
AdminConfig.aggregatorsHint: Sources allowed in the per-query aggregator chain. Skyscanner and Kayak are best-effort, gated by aggressive anti-bot protection on those sites.
AdminConfig.rateLimitsHint: Requests per minute per provider. Leave blank to use the conservative free tier defaults (Anthropic 50, Google 15, OpenAI 60, Groq 30). Raise these to match a paid API tier; lower them to stay under a quota.
AdminConfig.previewConcurrencyHint: Parallel browser instances for the create-time preview scrape. Higher is faster but uses more memory. Leave blank for the default (3).
AdminConfig.previewAdmissionCapHint: Max preview runs one client can have in flight at once. Leave blank for the default (3).
AdminConfig.scrapingHint: Pause to stop all background price checks, for example while away or over an API quota. Existing trackers and price history are kept.
AdminConfig.enterModelId: Enter a model ID before saving
AdminConfig.communityIntro: Flight Finder gets better when instances pool their price history. Turn on sharing to contribute your anonymized data points (route, price, airline, and date only, never anything personal) to a shared fare dataset everyone can explore, and in return you see community prices on routes you have not scraped yourself. It is fully opt-in and you can turn it off any time.
AdminConfig.sharingHint: Contribute this instance's anonymized prices (route, price, airline, date) to the community dataset.
AdminConfig.hubHint: Lets other Flight Finder instances register with this one and send their anonymized data here. Only relevant for the central hub. New registrations are rate limited and globally capped.
AdminConfig.apiKeyFromEnv: entered above (stored encrypted), or read from {envKey} if none is set
AdminConfig.apiKeyNotRequired: not required — this provider signs in through its local CLI, no API key needed

AdminNotifications.title: Notifications
AdminNotifications.intro: Get pushed an alert the moment a tracked flight hits a new low price. Add one or more channels below. Alerts fire after each scrape, so a headless instance never misses a fare.

thresholds.title: Alert thresholds
thresholds.minDropHint: Only alert when a new low beats the previous best by at least this much (in the tracker's currency). Default 5.
thresholds.minPctHint: Extra gate on top of the absolute drop. 0 disables it.
thresholds.publicUrlHint: Your instance's address, used for the chart link inside each alert. Set this (or the APP_URL environment variable) so alerts link back to your site; if left blank, alerts are sent without a link.

channels.title: Channels
channels.empty: No channels yet. Add one below.

AdminUsers.title: Users
AdminUsers.banner: {count, plural, one {# existing tracker was} other {# existing trackers were}} assigned to you when you enabled multi user mode. Reassign any that belong to other household members from the <link>admin trackers page</link>.
AdminUsers.deleteConfirm: Delete user {username}? Their trackers will become unowned.
AdminUsers.disableConfirm: Disable multi user mode? This turns off all logins and clears the admin password, reverting to a single user self hosted instance. Accounts stay in the database but become inaccessible until you re-enable multi user mode. Continue?
AdminUsers.dangerText: Turn off multi user mode and revert to a single user self hosted instance. Accounts are kept in the database but become inaccessible, and the admin password is cleared.

errors.disableMultiUser: Failed to disable multi user mode

addUser.title: Add user
addUser.note: Leave the password blank for a tap-to-sign-in member. Anyone who can reach this instance can sign in as a passwordless member, so add a password if it's public. Admins always need a password.

AdminUsers.inviteHint: Generates a link that opens the access gate for 24 hours. Share it, or let them scan the code.
